name: Dave Lowry
contribution: Built Project Spark — a quiz that matches you to demo ideas and exports a Cursor-ready .md brief.
headline: Stuck at the cafe? Get sparked.
summary: Not sure what to build at Cafe Cursor? Project Spark asks about your interests and time, suggests finishable demo ideas, and downloads a markdown brief you can paste straight into Cursor Agent.
body:
I wanted something useful for everyone sitting there thinking "what should I make?" — so I built Project Spark.

Answer four quick questions (or hit I'm feeling lucky), pick from matched project ideas sized for a cafe session, and download a .md file with MVP features, build steps, and a ready-to-go Cursor prompt.

Try it at /spark on this site, then go build something fun.
